level: mixed: park-level rows end with "park", point rows end with "point"
camps: Campgrounds: Black Rock campground. Sites: 78 wooded/open sites; some sites have electric and water hookups; dump station, bathrooms, showers. Cabins / lodging: Rustic cabins (available on limited seasonal schedule)

Campgrounds: Devil's Hopyard campground. Sites: 21 wooded sites; stream fishing; no running water or drinking water; no swimming. Open: 2026: Apr 10–Oct 12; 2027: Apr 9–Oct 11. Location: park street address (366 Hopyard Road, East Haddam, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Hopeville Pond campground. Sites: 80 wooded sites; dump station, bathrooms, showers, fishing, swimming; electric/water hookup sites listed. Cabins / lodging: Rustic cabin; 3-night minimum. Open: 2026: Apr 17–Oct 12; 2027: Apr 16–Oct 11. Location: park street address (929 Hopeville Road, Griswold, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Housatonic Meadows campground. Sites: 61 sites in rustic setting near Housatonic River; dump station, bathrooms, showers. Cabins / lodging: Rustic cabins; Friday/Saturday nights only, two-night minimum

Campgrounds: Kettletown campground. Sites: 61 partly wooded/open sites; dump station, bathrooms, showers; RV/trailer max 28 ft. Cabins / lodging: Rustic cabins. Open: Closed for 2026–2027 seasons due to flood damage. Location: park street address (1400 Georges Hill Road, Southbury, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Lake Waramaug campground. Sites: 76 wooded/open sites overlooking lake; dump station, bathrooms, showers, fishing, swimming. Cabins / lodging: Rustic cabins; Friday/Saturday nights only; two-night minimum. Location: park street address (30 Lake Waramaug Road, New Preston, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Macedonia Brook campground. Sites: 51 rustic sites; pit toilets; no bathrooms/showers or running water; stream fishing and hiking. Location: park street address (159 Macedonia Brook Road, Kent, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Mashamoquet Brook Campground; Wolf Den Campground. Sites: 18 wooded sites at Mashamoquet Brook ; 35 open sites at Wolf Den; bathrooms/showers at Wolf Den; portable toilets at Mashamoquet Brook. Open: 2027 dates also listed on official page. Location: park street address (320 Mashamoquet Road, Pomfret, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Mashamoquet Brook Campground; Wolf Den Campground. Sites: 18 wooded sites at Mashamoquet Brook ; 35 open sites at Wolf Den; bathrooms/showers at Wolf Den; portable toilets at Mashamoquet Brook. Open: 2027 dates also listed on official page. Location: park street address (147 Wolf Den Drive, Pomfret, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: Rocky Neck campground. Sites: 160 wooded/open sites; dump station, bathrooms, showers, concessions, saltwater fishing and swimming. Cabins / lodging: Rustic cabins; 7-night minimum, Sunday–Sunday only. Location: park street address (244 West Main Street, Niantic, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder

Campgrounds: People's State Forest group camping areas. Sites: Three group campsites: James Stocking (~35 campers), Big Spring (~50+), Ullmann Grove (~50+); each has pit toilet, firepit and picnic table. Open: Opens 3rd weekend in April; closes Dec 15

Campgrounds: Salt Rock State Forest Campground. Sites: 71 tent/RV sites; utilities at some sites; bathrooms, dump station and showers. Location: park street address (173 Scotland Road, Baltic, CT), placed by the US Census geocoder
Campgrounds: Silvermine Horse Camp. Sites: 15 wooded equestrian sites; basic facilities; no water (campers bring their own). Open: 2026: Apr 10–Thanksgiving Day; 2027: Apr 9–Thanksgiving Day

Campgrounds: Green Falls Campground; Mt. Misery Campground; Frog Hollow Horse Camp. Sites: Green Falls: 18 wooded sites ; Mt. Misery: 22 wooded sites ; Frog Hollow: 18 semi-wooded horse sites, two composting toilets. Open: Green Falls and Mt. Misery 2026: Apr 10–Oct 12; 2027: Apr 9–Oct 11. Frog Hollow dates follow the same seasonal window
